constraints.pass_recording: Apply the selected criteria before recording a pass with artifact record-review --input -. Record evidence, applicability, and separate lens findings. A pass is external judgment, not applicant acceptance.
constraints.dual_lens_review: Read once for candidate intent/voice and once for reader relevance and credibility; use an executive lens only when applicable. Keep the findings distinct.
constraints.keyword_grounding: Ground claimed capabilities in evidence. Use meaningful role terminology and synonyms; a missing literal keyword is not proof of ATS rejection. Flag unsupported specialist claims.

templates.label: Submission confirmation card
templates.purpose: Obtain one precise confirmation for channel, evidence, and transmitted artifacts.

templates.label: Outcome closing card
templates.purpose: Close an opportunity without inventing dates or reasons.

templates.label: Executive CV structure
templates.purpose: Provide a stable executive CV reading order while leaving role-specific writing external.

constraints.candidate_owned_headline: Use transferable language grounded in the candidate's own roles and evidence. Never copy, prefix with, or lightly rewrite the opportunity title or its capability taxonomy.
constraints.canonical_facts: Preserve selected source wording for credentials, dates, grades, and other identity facts. Do not alternate between degree labels across applications.
constraints.education_completeness: Include all confirmed distinguishing modules or international components selected by the context source unless the user explicitly requests omission.
constraints.evidence_boundary: direct and transferable evidence must remain distinguishable
writing_guardrails: Lead each evidence bullet with the competence the role needs, then the proof — not chronology.
Cut self-promotional or marketing verbs (e.g. 'turns X into Y', 'a translator who keeps everyone moving').
No section labels that break prose flow (e.g. a literal 'Profile:' prefix).
Match the role's own true domain keywords early; never claim an unearned skill — reframe truthfully instead.
Vary sentence rhythm; put the strongest numbers at the start of their own sentences, not buried in subordinate clauses.
State seniority/level explicitly and early for Director+ targets.
Use the applicant's chosen opening: identity and contribution, a chronological summary, or another supported form. Keep proof and scale in the appropriate evidence sections.
Group substantiated capabilities according to the applicant's preference and channel constraints, including a domain table or a plain list.
Ground each identity or leadership claim in concrete responsibilities or outcomes. Do not infer a profile archetype from the vacancy.
Use verified scale facts when they clarify relevant authority; do not invent scale or force them into the opening.
Every capability must be supported by experience evidence; choose its layout and length for the applicant and channel.
constraints.applicability: Optional executive variant; select only when this seniority and structure match the applicant and request.

templates.label: Application package contract
templates.purpose: Keep package scope, authorization, canonical sources, renditions, and registration consistent.

constraints.authorization: A direct request to prepare, create, revise, or register an application package authorizes the in-scope private files and Nextstep registration needed for that package. Do not ask again for ordinary drafting or rendition creation.
constraints.visual_qa: Follow explicit applicant/workspace visual-QA preferences. Report structural and visual checks separately; only a passed visual check supports visually_verified.
constraints.canonical_markdown: Markdown remains authoritative and DOCX remains a rendition unless confirmed transmitted evidence says otherwise.

templates.label: Executive application letter structure
templates.purpose: Keep a company-problem-first letter concise and evidence-bounded.

writing_guardrails: State a thesis/mechanism for the company's real problem, not a restated résumé; use 2 tightly chosen proofs, not a career tour.
Cut self-promotional or marketing verbs (e.g. 'turns X into Y', 'a translator who keeps everyone moving').
Match the role's own true domain keywords early; never claim an unearned skill — reframe truthfully instead.
Vary sentence rhythm; put the strongest numbers at the start of their own sentences, not buried in subordinate clauses.
Disclose real gaps plainly, every revision round, not just the first draft.
constraints.applicability: Use when the requested channel and applicant preferences call for this form. Exact form prompts, limits and user instructions take precedence.

templates.label: Application form answer

templates.label: Executive outreach structure
templates.purpose: Create a concise calibration message for a recruiter, founder, or hiring leader.

constraints.compensation: defer until mutual relevance unless explicitly needed

templates.label: Optional applicant guidance
templates.purpose: Resolve consequential gaps without a mandatory sequence or applicant archetype.

constraints.questions: Default one; at most three. Zero is valid. One optional round per deliverable unless deeper refinement is requested.
constraints.persistence: Explicit, scoped selected answers only; stable identity and voice remain external.
constraints.judgment: The external agent owns coaching, interpretation and prose quality.

templates.label: Applicant and audience review
templates.purpose: Explain artifact quality against the selected intent and channel.

constraints.semantic: External judgment with criterion rationale and evidence; no automated persuasion score.
